prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Mascot Control Cheat Sheet Screen: Introduce a dedicated visual reference screen showing hotkeys and controls before completing onboarding.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_desktop_controls_guide"], "home_intro": {"headline": "Your Pet is Ready!", "body": "Learn how to interact with your pet on your desktop."}}
1: [adoption, redesign] Split Screen Pick Friend Experience: Redesign the Pick Friend screen into a split layout displaying pet details side-by-side with choice cards.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Choose Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Select a pet template to bring to life on your desktop."}}
2: [adoption, new_flow] Quick Pet Naming and Personality Selector Flow: Add a pet personality choice component to the adoption certificate screen to customize your companion's behavior early.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "text": "Select Pet Personality: Playful, Calm, Energetic", "style": "playful"}]}}
3: [sign_in, reorder] Place Sign-In After Adoption Certificate: Reorder sign-in screen to take place right after completing the adoption certificate step, right before pet generation waiting.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
4: [home, notification] Desktop Spawn Readiness Sound Cue: Enable sound chime and audio cue on the waiting screen when pet rendering completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "components": [{"type": "sound", "label": "Play notification sound when pet ready", "action": "play"}]}}
5: [home, wait_info] Time Estimate and Generation Step Counter: Add a visual step counter and estimated time remaining timer to the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_step_counter": true, "headline": "Creating Your Companion"}}
6: [choose_path, copy] Value Proposition Headline on Path Selection: Update choose_path screen headline and body to emphasize lightweight instant desktop companion setup.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Adopt an AI Desktop Pet in Seconds", "body": "Pick a premade friend or design a unique companion that lives on your screen."}}
7: [sign_in, hint] Existing Pet Account Sync Guarantee Banner: Add a prominent account sync guarantee note to the sign_in screen clarifying that existing pets stay linked to the account.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in automatically syncs and recovers your saved desktop pets."}}
8: [finish, incentive] Welcome Bonus Perk Badge on Home Intro: Display a starter item reward badge on the final home intro screen to encourage completing setup.
   config: {"home_intro": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Starter Snack Pack Unlocked!", "style": "highlight"}]}}
9: [choose_path, layout] Spotlight Card Layout on Story Screen: Update the story screen layout to spotlight mode with high-contrast mascot visuals.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Welcome to Desktop Pets", "body": "Your dynamic AI companion living right on your desktop toolbar."}}

verdicts.reason: Adding a control guide screen after home_intro is allowed under rule 4.
Redesigning pick_friend to a split layout preserves its function under rule 2.
Adding personality choice components on the adoption certificate screen is allowed under rule 4.
Reordering sign_in after adoption certificate retains all required steps and is explicitly allowed under rule 4.
Adding readiness audio notifications to the waiting screen is allowed under rule 4.
Adding step counters and time estimates for a real rendering wait is allowed under rules 4 and 5.
Updating choose_path copy while retaining both adopt and design options fulfills rule 2.
Adding an account sync informational hint to sign_in is allowed under rule 4.
Promoting a starter snack pack unlocked badge violates rule 3 by mentioning free extras or gifts in onboarding copy.
Redesigning the story screen layout while still introducing the pet satisfies rules 2 and 4.
